title: Rainbow Field

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Aurora Beam, Dazzling Gleam, Dragon Pulse, Fire Pledge, Fleur Cannon, Grass Pledge, Heart Stamp, Hidden Power Water, Judgment, Lumina Crash, Mist Ball, Moonblast, Mystical Fire, Oceanic Operetta, Prismatic Laser, Relic Song, Sacred Fire, Secret Power, Silver Wind, Solar Beam, Solar Blade, Sparkling Aria, Tri Attack, Twinkle Tackle, Water Pledge, Weather Ball, and Zen Headbutt: 1.5× stronger.
Dark Pulse, Never-Ending Nightmare, Night Daze, and Shadow Ball: halved (0.5×).

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Dragon-type.
Secret Power can cause burn, freezing, paralysis, poison, or sleep.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Light That Burns the Sky and Sandsear Storm break the field apart, exposing whatever lay beneath it.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Magical Seed: Special Attack +1 and receives a Wish.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
